_about: Built-in English language file and the TEMPLATE for new languages. The keys are the program's English texts (never change them), the values are what is shown. To add a language: copy this file into the Langs folder (%APPDATA%\TaskManager\Langs), change "code" (e.g. "de" or "pt-BR") and "name" (the language's own name), and translate the values. Placeholders such as {0} and {1} are filled in by the program and must stay in the translation.
